text:
A tank contains water. Ripples are produced on the surface of the water.
What causes the ripples to refract?
A
The cold water in the tank is replaced by warm water.
B
The ripples change speed as they move from deep to shallow water.
C
The ripples hit the wall of the tank.
D
The ripples pass through a narrow gap.

options.label: A
options.text: The cold water in the tank is replaced by warm water.

options.label: B
options.text: The ripples change speed as they move from deep to shallow water.

options.label: C
options.text: The ripples hit the wall of the tank.

options.label: D
options.text: The ripples pass through a narrow gap.
